# bvbrcGoldStd

<!-- badges: start -->
[![Lifecycle: experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html#experimental)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/JRaviLab/bvbrcGoldStd/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/JRaviLab/bvbrcGoldStd/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

bvbrcGoldStd is a versioned gold-standard metadata resource for BV-BRC/NCBI
bacterial isolate metadata — host, isolation source, and related fields —
starting with *Staphylococcus aureus* and extending to the ESKAPE pathogens.

## Overview

- Curated reference tables for host, isolation-source, geography, and
  drug/AMR metadata cleanup — see [`inst/extdata/`](inst/extdata/README.md)
  for the full data layout.
- An evaluation harness (in progress) to score candidate/LLM-derived
  metadata mappings against the gold standard.

## Installation

``` r
# Install from GitHub
if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("remotes")

remotes::install_github("JRaviLab/bvbrcGoldStd")
```

## Related repos

bvbrcGoldStd supplies the harmonized metadata used by the [amR
suite](https://github.com/JRaviLab/amR) for antimicrobial resistance
prediction:

| Package | Description | Repository |
|----|----|----|
| **amR** | Metapackage for the AMR-prediction suite | [JRaviLab/amR](https://github.com/JRaviLab/amR) |
| **amRdata** | Data curation and feature extraction from bacterial genomes | [JRaviLab/amRdata](https://github.com/JRaviLab/amRdata) |
| **amRml** | Machine learning models for AMR prediction | [JRaviLab/amRml](https://github.com/JRaviLab/amRml) |
| **amRviz** | Interactive dashboard for exploring results | [JRaviLab/amRviz](https://github.com/JRaviLab/amRviz) |
